title: Dominic and the Group Chat
author: Isandro Zhou
blurb: Wendell Vane, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must save the tradition that made the town before graduation.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
